messages:
alexander: heads up — onboarding a regulated customer asking for BYOK backed by an HSM (FIPS-level). They want strict custody boundaries, per-key RBAC, and 1y audit retention. Can we confirm gaps vs current flow?

tammy: noted. do we have an example mapping for per-key roles? iirc we supported key-level ACLs in the proxy but not surfaced in the console yet. @zane can you confirm? :thinking_face: 

zane: yep — HSM proxy supports PKCS#11 ACLs + a mapping table we maintain in secrets. currently mapping is service-account -> key-id with read/use flags. we don't have UI for delegating to customer admins; that's manual today.

maria: important: audit logs need to include key-id, requestor identity, operation, and attestation nonce for HSM unwraps. retention 1y is ok but must be immutable (WORM). is our log pipeline compatible?

security-bot: ALERT: previous deploy (2026-01-12) changed kms-client to v2.3.1 — contains new retry logic. No known CVE.

alexander: two immediate questions: (1) RBAC changes — do we need a new role model (customer-admin, cust-operator, redwood-ops) scoped per-customer key shard? (2) Audit — can we route HSM audit events to the client's ingestion (S3+KMS) or ship via our retention with attestations?

tammy: (1) yes, we should formalize: customer-admin (manage key metadata, rotate policies), cust-operator (use for unwrap/derive), redwood-ops (infrastructure ops — no plaintext access). need cross-account role for on-prem HSM case.

zane: (2) For routing, two patterns: a) customer-managed sink (we push signed, batched events to their S3 endpoint) or b) we keep events and provide signed attestations for each unwrap call. Pattern a) is nicer for audit sovereignty but increases integration surface (S3 access, VPC peering).

maria: also flag: compliance teams asked for key provenance chain in reports (who created, which HSM slot, firmware version, attestation). we need automated collection during onboarding.

alexander: about vuln triage — oncall-rot found a transient bug where ephemeral creds leaked in logs during a failed handshake (non-prod only). severity low but we should include it in the onboarding checklist.

oncall-rot: reproduced locally. stack: hsm-proxy 1.12 -> log line printed creds on WARN when retrying handshake. patch ready, will scrub logs and rotate test keys.

tammy: good. action items I hear: 1) formalize RBAC model doc + config schema, 2) add per-key audit entry schema and WORM retention requirements, 3) design integration pattern for customer-managed sink (S3+signing) and fallback attestation-only flow, 4) add log-scrub + rotation step to onboarding runbook. I'll make a PR with the RBAC proposal.

zane: I'll open a small design doc for the event-sink contract (signed batches, replay protection, ordering) and prototype S3 push.

maria: I'll work with compliance to list required provenance fields and draft the onboarding checklist items (firmware attestation, HSM model, slot id, nonce flows).

alexander: thanks all. can we aim for draft PRs by EOD Friday? also tagging @tammy for priority. :+1:

security-bot: NOTE: ticket SEC-4219 created for the handshake log leak; severity: low; assignee: oncall-rot.

oncall-rot: ack, will rotate keys and push patch to canary tomorrow morning.

alexander: perfect. small follow-up — please include a short example audit event for the onboarding doc. here's a quick sketch: ```{
  "ts": 1719456789,
  "event": "hsm.unseal",
  "key_id": "cust-0123:slot-7",
  "requestor": "arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/cust-operator/session",
  "attestation_nonce": "4d9f...",
  "result": "success"
}```

tammy: copying that to the PR. thanks.

maria: adding WORM note and signed-batch spec. will ping compliance for legal wording on custody boundaries.

alexander: closing loop — if anyone surfaces a blocker today ping me directly.
